rationale_per_step.search-response-cache-policy: The search route embeds a query and then runs a hybrid ranking on every request, including the identical repeat a reader makes by pressing enter twice, and it sends no cache headers at all, so nothing between the reader and the database is allowed to help. A short explicit policy on the route, with the reasoning written down, is the smallest change that makes the cost of a repeat request a decision rather than an accident. Nothing in flight touches that route.
